query:
SELECT lf.name, ffs.transactionType, ffs.legalFee, ffs.leaseholdSupplement, ffs.antiMoneyLaunderingFee, ffs.fileOpeningFee
FROM firm_fee_structures ffs
JOIN law_firms lf ON lf.id = ffs.firmId
WHERE ffs.transactionType = 'sale'
ORDER BY lf.name, ffs.minValue;
